# Pets and Farm Update: build run (read this first)

Made by the Plan chat, 1 Nov 2026. Approved by Karolis (plan-production): build all 6 stages on a hidden branch, release once.

## Where everything is
- Game: GitHub cute-games/cozy-town. Start from main (a47bb1a, 29 Oct, version 2026102902). Players only see main.
- Main Book (claude.ai artifact): https://claude.ai/artifact/6VamW3iTDycZZjZnfTrZa3
  - Database (ArtifactData tool): collection `entries` (plans, rules, story, prices: read by id), collection `kits` (this doc, economy patch, map files).
  - Published files (Artifact tool, action read, path): tools/model-pack/ (non-living, 112 items), tools/living-pack/ (living, 57 items), tools/moves-pack/ (moves), tools/moves/KIT.md (kept versions!), tools/sounds.html (new sounds, copy tone() recipes as they are), tools/sneak-peek.html (screens), tools/town/ (copy of the game, do not use as source).
- Stage briefs: entries plan-brief-pfu-1 … plan-brief-pfu-6 (approved). Each lists the rule, story, model, move and screen entries it needs: read those entries by id.
- Kits (collection `kits`): `economy-rebalance` (git patch on a47bb1a, stage 1), `pfu-placements` + `pfu-scene` + `pfu-scene-readme` (map: farm, trail, jump field, vet clinic, Pet Show area, deleted/moved town things, townCodeChanges).
- If you cannot read the book (no ArtifactData / Artifact tool): STOP, write that in HANDOFF.md, end. Do not guess content.

## Branches (ACTUAL, 1 Nov): build branch = claude/exciting-feynman-ea1031 (the session could only push there; it replaces 'pfu' everywhere below). Backup = backup-2026-10-31 (main a47bb1a).
1. First chat only: create `backup-2026-11-01` from main, then branch `pfu` from main. Copy what you read from the book into `pfu/kit/` (briefs, entries you use, packs, map files) so later chats read files, not the book.
2. Every stage commits to `pfu`. Never push to main. No pull request until all 6 stages pass.

## One chat, one helper per stage (Karolis, 1 Nov)
Karolis uses ONE Claude Code chat for all 6 stages. That chat is the foreman: it keeps its own context small and runs each stage in a fresh helper (Agent tool), one stage at a time, in order. The helper gets: this doc, HANDOFF.md, its stage brief; it builds, runs the quick kit, commits to pfu, updates HANDOFF.md and returns a short report (check output + what is not verified). The foreman reads only the report and the quick kit result, then starts the next stage. The foreman never reads big files itself. After stage 6 the foreman runs the full check (helpers for pictures), fixes, and opens the one pull request. If the foreman chat itself gets long (about 300k context), it writes HANDOFF.md and tells Karolis to open a new chat with the Continue line.

## Order and handoff
Stages in order 1 → 6. One stage per helper. At the end of each stage: quick kit run, commit, update HANDOFF.md (1 page: done, next stage, open problems, exact commit), then STOP. The next chat starts from HANDOFF.md on `pfu`.
If usage runs out mid-stage: commit what builds and passes, write HANDOFF.md with the exact next step.

## Checks (Karolis, 1 Nov)
- After each stage: quick kit (files, counts, saves, feature lines) — cheap.
- Full check ONCE, after stage 6, on `pfu`: every screen, button, menu, area; two players in the shared room; iPad (touch, Safari) and PC (keyboard); light + dark; old saves from today's main. Pictures only where the update touched, viewed by Sonnet helpers. Then fixes, then ONE pull request pfu → main. Karolis merges.
- The final check must never get weaker. Kit line N8 fails on today's main (fixture save-prepet1-designer2.json missing): add the fixture, never weaken the line.
- New check lines for the new features: add them in each stage, failing by default until the feature works.

## Safety rules (project rules, unchanged)
Old saves keep working for every player. Count buildings/items/areas before and after. Test only on a copy. Test data marked ZZTEST and undone. Never delete or rename Karolis's work. Opus 5.5 medium effort.

## Size limit (Plan, 1 Nov, after the stage 4 pause)
The old 1.8 MB rule came from when the game was ONE index.html that the Home Screen app re-downloaded on every update check, and from the Claude copy (dropped 22 Oct). Since the split (PR #10) index.html is small. Proposed new limit, waiting for Karolis's yes: joined game up to 3.0 MB, PLUS a speed guard (30+ fps on an iPad-sized view with 2 players, first load measured and reported). Never a second copy of an existing game builder.
Order after continuing: first build what stage 4 left out (big pets with homes, gear and snake tank; bear and seal waiting outside; the 3-floor Pet Shop; today's pets redrawn to the picks), then stages 5 and 6.
Check line B1: do not only check that the field exists; compare the value with a small tolerance (like P1). Report every check line you change, old -> new.

## Guards from the Plan red team (1 Nov) — must hold
1. Book access test FIRST (2 minutes): read this doc, one brief, one pack file. If any fails: STOP, report, end.
2. Saves every stage: the quick kit must load saves from today's main AND from the previous stage, and round-trip them (save → load → same). One save version bump for the whole update, done in stage 1, with a migration that fills new fields with defaults.
3. Size and speed budget: the packs are copies of Model Compare and contain the game's own model code too. Take ONLY the builders the update uses, never a second copy of an existing game builder. Report game file size before/after each stage. Farm trees, bushes and rocks are instanced (speed test: 5000 separate trees ~6 fps, instanced ~122 fps). Stage 6 must keep 30+ fps on an iPad-sized view with 2 players.
4. Online data stays small: friends' pet mood/move = short codes at the END of the pet array; old versions must ignore it.
5. One stage at a time, in order; never start a stage while the previous one fails its quick kit. If a stage fails twice on the same problem: write HANDOFF.md with the root cause and stop.
6. Version stamp stays inside index.html (old iPad Home Screen copies must find the update).
7. At the end, write the "Try it for real" tasks (sound, feel, real friends together) for Karolis and Izabele; those stay NOT VERIFIED until they tick them.

## Corrections after the briefs were written (newest wins)
- Vet = Dr. Rūta (living pack game_name; NOT Dr. Fern). Lobby nurse = Nurse Penny = Mila's model. Dr. Tomas and Vet nurse Leo stay as staff.
- Pets: ONE need, happiness (rules-dec-one-need). No hunger. Food is one of the ways to raise happiness.
- Farm animals are only baby or adult: the placement "Horse (teen)" (o39) is built as an adult horse.
- Stan's lesson: no log; step 4 jumps o122 (Little cross). Flags course:flag blue + red now exist in the model pack: place them at blue (-174,-116), red (-189,-114).
- Use KEPT model versions, not model defaults (tools/moves/KIT.md "Kept versions"): pomchi v:'game', pug v:'new', seal look:'spotted', capybara v:'real', bear v:'teddy' (6 looks), coach ieva/stan, cowgirl rose, cowboy cody/hank.
- Toys: one model per toy type (petball, squeakybone ChatGPT versions; toy:frisbee, toy:mouse).
- Hamster gear at scale 4.4. Trough rim 0.34. Snake basket open top. Terrarium hide empty.
- Known limits, accepted: no knees/elbows (people hop up steps), horse eats from the hand with the head barely lowered. Move polish = the update after this one.
- No new models in this update (Karolis 31 Oct: models frozen).

## Stage 1 extras
Apply the economy-rebalance patch first (COZY_BUILD 2026103101), then night skip, morning bus home, hats-in-hair fix.

## Reporting (each stage, in HANDOFF.md and the chat)
Check output exactly as printed first, then what was built and fixed, then what was not checked (NOT VERIFIED). Plain words, short sentences.
